protocol.hypothesis: A single shared factor model borrows common resource/HP/intent statistics across all five characters, with existing character/relic observations supplying learned interactions.
protocol.selectionRule: One global candidate for all characters: minimum macro mean over native characters, then encounter families, then root mean clipped[-40,40] pair logistic loss from the existing C# audit. Exact tie prefers linear, otherwise greater regularization. All preference kinds retained; report them separately. Zero-pair roots excluded with counts.
protocol.fullFitGate: Advance ONLY if chosen shared inner macro loss is no worse than the prior independently selected character bank. Accuracy remains a separate diagnostic; never choose using outer battles.
protocol.sharedPreparationCaveat: Global row sampler/order is unchanged. C# feature support is now across all roles and pair-shuffle RNG is shared instead of restarting per character; graph subsets/order can change. Record sampled-row, pair-kind and participating-row counts; this is a whole-pipeline comparison, not an isolated parameter-tying causal experiment.
protocol.fullFit: Re-export all 376 original roots with shared preparation, fit only the selected regularization; if linear, use the new shared foundation. Never reuse the old five-head foundation.
protocol.searchGate: Single chosen full-data artifact gets original five outer-development cases, then ten only with no regression or unverified evidence; final sealed.
